scripts.test: npm run compile && NODE_ENV=test CONDUIT_TEST_MEMORY=true node --test $(find dist -name '*.test.js') scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile && NODE_ENV=test CONDUIT_TEST_MEMORY=true node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude='dist/**/*.test.js' --test-coverage-lines=64 --test-coverage-branches=70 --test-coverage-functions=66 $(find dist -name '*.test.js')
